dev_role: Repeatedly used development set. All selection and quality conclusions exploratory, no independent test/confirmation claim. No test inference.
hypothesis: Single original-FP16 decoder-block restoration in Q4 may restore first-token ranking and some lost answers; numeric recovery need not improve task quality. No assumption of outliers, attention causality, or novel algorithm.
selection_rule: Maximize restored FP16 top1 count on six fixed losses, then minimize mean absolute change from FP16 top1-vs-top2 pair margin, then lowest block index.
control_rule: (selected_block + 12) % 24; same architecture and FP16 tensor-byte cost. Not chosen by observed quality.

quality.format_valid_warning: Includes exact substring constraint; not a pure formatting measure.

benchmark.order: cyclic Latin rotation of variants by round; fresh subprocess each cell, serial execution
benchmark.timing: Pre-tokenized input prepared/evaluated and fresh floating KV allocated before timer; synchronized first token; decode excludes first token; no diagnostic logits conversion in timed path. No loading/tokenization/network/queueing included.
benchmark.memory: Fresh process; sampled RSS at 10ms includes loading/warmups; MLX peak active plus cache separately; overlapping unified memory counters must not be summed.

stop_rule: One selection, one matched control, one quality run per variant, five balanced performance rounds; no alternative block or prompt retry after seeing results. Preserve negative result.
raw_logits: Top10 logits plus FP16 top1/top2 pair logits and full-vocabulary reference-top1 rank stored per prompt. No claim of full-vector error/outlier diagnosis.
